text:
emma_csm: Quick sync — Helios Health wants a 90-min enablement: onboarding + best practices + handoff to support. Renewal touchpoint is in 6 weeks, so we need to prioritize output and adoption. Can folks help lock a date this week? :calendar:
devon_enable: I can run the workshop. Prefer Wed or Thu mornings PST. Suggest 90m to include Q&A + breakouts. :+1:
remi_se: Can we add a short infra checklist and a live model demo? 20m demo, 10m infra Q&A. Need access to their staging keys beforehand.
olivia_ops: Recording + transcript required for their legal team. Also would like to capture session feedback via a quick form at the end. I can create a 5-question Typeform.
sanjay_success: Heads up — Helios flagged lower usage on embeddings which is part of negotiation risk. Agenda should include specific adoption metrics and action items tied to success plan. We should book a separate follow-up for metrics review if they can't get to it in 90m. :warning:
emma_csm: Good — here's a proposed schedule (90m):
```
00:00 - 00:05  Intro & goals (Emma)
00:05 - 00:25  Product walkthrough: embeddings & reranking (Devon)
00:25 - 00:45  Live demo: end-to-end flow + sample prompts (Remi)
00:45 - 00:55  Infra & deployment checklist (Remi/Olivia)
00:55 - 01:10  Breakout rooms: integration + ops
01:10 - 01:25  Metrics, adoption playbook & Qs (Sanjay)
01:25 - 01:30  Next steps + feedback form (Emma)
```
devon_enable: Works for me. For demo, I need a sample dataset and staging endpoint by EOD Monday. Can someone ping the Helios engineer?
emma_csm: @Helios_Eng has been cc'd on the ticket but I'll DM them.
calendar_bot: Proposed slots created — please vote: https://calendar.redwood.ai/propose/helio-enable (Wed 09:00 PST / Thu 11:00 PST / Fri 08:00 PST) :ballot_box:
olivia_ops: I'll spin up the Typeform and set up a recording + upload workflow to the customer S3. Need the S3 bucket name from Helios and permission grant.
sanjay_success: I'll prepare a 1-slide adoption snapshot template we can populate during the session. If renewal is risk-tier yellow/red, recommend we include exec join for the metrics portion.
remi_se: For breakouts — two rooms: integration (Dev) and infra (Ops). I'll draft the breakout prompts and a 10-line troubleshooting checklist to share.
emma_csm: Two quick asks before we finalize: 1) Confirm timezone with Helios (they're CET-based but had US team too). 2) Who will own action items in follow-up? Prefer to assign owners during the session.
devon_enable: Ok to have me own demo follow-ups. Olivia for recordings/ops, Sanjay for adoption items. Emma will own overall follow-ups and renewal flag.
emma_csm: Perfect. If no objections I'll finalize the slot and send invites + pre-read (30-min checklist and short pre-survey) by EOD. :rocket:
devon_enable: No objections here.
olivia_ops: All good from ops. I'll attach the feedback form link to the calendar invite.
sanjay_success: Good to go. I'll also prep a short slide calling out current usage and recommended next steps (3 items).
emma_csm: Great — finalizing once poll hits majority. Thanks everyone! :clap:
